IGUI_MIR_RestockTooltip: Places matching items from your inventory into every empty remembered position on linked racks.
IGUI_MIR_RememberTooltip: Select a nearby item placed with Extended 3D Placement, then choose what type of replacement this position accepts.
IGUI_MIR_AllNearbyItemsTooltip: Remembers every nearby item currently placed with Extended 3D Placement. Each position accepts that exact item type.
IGUI_MIR_ForgetTooltip: Removes a saved position from the rack. Its wooden pegs disappear with it.
IGUI_MIR_RemoveAllTooltip: Returns every displayed item on this rack to your inventory and forgets all of this rack's remembered positions.
IGUI_MIR_ShowBoardTooltip: Shows or hides this rack's wooden pegboard without changing its remembered positions or restocking behaviour.
IGUI_MIR_ShowPegsTooltip: Shows or hides this rack's support pegs without changing its remembered positions or restocking behaviour.
IGUI_MIR_InstallTooltip: Snaps the rack upright to a nearby wall. Press the Rotate Building key to choose another wall side.
IGUI_MIR_RemovedAll: Removed %1 displayed item(s) and cleared this rack
IGUI_MIR_InstallFailed: The rack could not be installed there
IGUI_MIR_InstallUnavailable: Wall placement is not ready yet. Try again after entering the world.
IGUI_MIR_RemoveRackTooltip: Returns this rack to your inventory and clears only its remembered positions. Nearby racks are not changed.
IGUI_MIR_RemoveFailed: The rack could not be removed
